bb-a-USD is a liquidity pool token that represents a share in a Balancer boosted stable pool. bb-a-USD operates on the Ethereum blockchain. bb-a-USD is linked to Aave lending tokens, which are yield-bearing stablecoins.

UNI/WETH is a trading pair of the UNI token and wrapped Ether. UNI/WETH is traded on Uniswap, a decentralized exchange. UNI/WETH is operated on the Ethereum blockchain without a centralized intermediary.

Orca is a decentralized exchange on the Solana blockchain. Orca uses automated market maker pools for token swaps. Orca offers concentrated liquidity pools, called Whirlpools.

Raydium is an automated market maker and liquidity provider on the Solana blockchain. Raydium is connected to the Serum central limit order book for trading. Raydium allows users to provide liquidity and earn trading fees.

Gnosis protocol is a decentralized exchange on the Ethereum blockchain. Gnosis protocol settles trades through batch auctions. Gnosis protocol relies on competing solvers to find settlement solutions for batches of orders.
